data.name: Tamas
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hungarian word ‘tamad,’ meaning ‘to give.’ This name is believed to have been given by God to the first Hungarian king, Attila. It is a strong and powerful name, symbolizing divine protection and guidance.

data.cultural_impact: The name ‘Tamas’ holds significant cultural resonance in Hungarian and Christian traditions. It is a name with a rich historical background and has been passed down through generations. ‘Tamas’ was the name of the first King of the Magyars (Hungarians) and is celebrated as a symbol of Hungarian national pride.
data.spiritual_significance: Among Christians, the name ‘Tamas’ carries a deep spiritual significance. It is believed that the name was given to King Attila by God, and as such, it symbolizes divine favor and protection. In the Christian faith, the name ‘Tamas’ can be seen as a reminder of the power and presence of God in our lives. It is a name that inspires strength, courage, and faith, and is a source of comfort and inspiration for those who bear it.
